apropos.title: Noma da Haɓaka Ƙwarewa a Tsakiyar Sahel.
apropos.description: OPE Agadez wani gagarumin shiri ne mai nufin bayyana da ɗaukaka basirar matasan Nijar. Mun yi imani cewa ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire na fitowa ne daga haɗin gadonmu na al'ada da kuma fasahohin zamani.
apropos.pilier_1_desc: Samun damar shiga shirye-shiryen horo na musamman don magance ƙalubalen fasaha na yanzu da na gaba.
apropos.pilier_2_desc: Muna canza tunani zuwa aiyuka na zahiri. Ta hanyar samar da kayan aiki, jagoranci da tsari mai kyau, muna taimakawa wajen kafa sabbin kamfanoni masu amfani ga al'umma.
apropos.pilier_3_desc: Haɗa matasa masu basira da ƙwararrun malamai da shugabannin masana'antu don ƙulla alaƙa mai ɗorewa.
apropos.inspiration_quote: Hamada ba cikas ba ce, matattakalar ƙara fahimta da basira ce.
apropos.timeline_subtitle: Gano muhimman matakan da suka kafa tarihin da tasirin OPE Agadez tun kafuwarta.
apropos.stats_mentors: Masu Ba da Horon da ke Aiki
apropos.editorial_title: A tsakiyar dutsen Aïr, Agadez na sabunta cibiyar ƙwarewar Nijar.
apropos.editorial_quote: Tsohon birnin tarihi da UNESCO ta amince da shi, Agadez ya kasance cibiyar ilimi tun ƙarni da dama. A nan ne OPE ke tara matasa don CNCEIZ.
apropos.editorial_p1: Bayan gagarumar nasarar da wakilan Nijar suka samu a Hood College a 2024, sansanin yana da manufar horas da matasa ƙwararru masu kishin ƙasa.
apropos.editorial_p2: Shirin zai fara a watan Nuwamba 2026 a dukkan yankuna takwas da Timia domin horas da matasa 1,500. A watan Disamba, wakilai 1,000 za su taru a Agadez.
apropos.hood_p1: Lokacin zafi 2024. Matasan jakadun Nijar takwas sun daga tutar ƙasa a sansanin UNESCO Center for Peace a Hood College.
apropos.hood_p2: Nasarori a IMUN, lambar yabo ta farko a STEAM ƙarƙashin ƙungiyar Sigma, da lambobin yabo 2 ga OPE.
apropos.pillars_subtitle: Tsari da aka yi don buɗe fasahar matasa da kawo mafita ga yankin Sahel.
apropos.p_education_sub: Koyi ta hanyar aikatawa don gina gobe.
apropos.p_education_desc: Horon fasaha, kimiyya da wayar da kan 'yan ƙasa, tarukan bita da jagorancin ƙwararru.
apropos.p_tech_sub: Lokacin da matasa ke kera makomar Nijar.
apropos.p_tech_desc: AI, roba, kimiyyar halittu, fasaha da lissafi a cikin tarukan STEAM a Agadez.
apropos.p_impact_sub: Sansanin da ke barin kyakkyawar shaida.
apropos.p_impact_desc: Shuka bishiyoyi, gyaran azuzuwa, taron zaman lafiya da rabon kayan hasken rana.
apropos.p_tourism_title: Yawon Buɗe Ido, Al'ada da Wasanni
apropos.p_tourism_desc: Yawon shakatawa na tarihi, haɓaka kayan gargajiya da wasannin motsa jiki ga matasa.
apropos.p_network_sub: Haɗuwa da ke buɗe sabbin damammaki.
apropos.p_network_desc: Haɗa matasa masu fasaha da ƙwararrun shugabannin kasuwanci.

acteurs.hero_subtitle: Shugabannin hukumomi da abokan hulɗa — ku saurari sakonnin waɗanda ke mayar da CNCEIZ gaskiya.
acteurs.presi_quote: Jamhuriyar Nijar ita ce ƙasa mafi yawan matasa a duniya. Wannan ba ƙalubale ba ne kawai, babban arzikinmu ne da ya kamata a yi amfani da shi.
acteurs.presi_p1: Akwai ayyukan da ke tasowa daga babban ƙudurori. Sansanin Ƙasa na 'Yan Ƙasa don Ƙwarewa da Ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire na ɗaya daga cikinsu, domin ba matasa damar nuna abin da za su iya.
acteurs.presi_p2: Matasa a Niamey, Zinder, Maradi, Tahoua da Agadez na kera sabbin abubuwa masu amfani. Abin da suke buƙata shi ne dandamali na ƙasa don nuna bajintarsu.
acteurs.presi_p3: Wannan sansani shi ne dandamalin da zai karrama fasahar matasanmu.
acteurs.presi_p4: Zaɓar birnin Agadez mai tarihi da al'ada alama ce mai ƙarfi da ke nuna ƙwarewar Nijar a tarihin duniya.
acteurs.presi_p5: Muna gayyatar ku ku kasance tare da mu a matsayin masu ginawa ba kawai masu bayar da gudummawa ba.
acteurs.sg_quote: Suna roƙon a saurare su, a ba su jagoranci kuma a ba su dama su nuna ƙwarewarsu. Sansanin CNCEIZ shi ne amsar mu.
acteurs.sg_p1: Wasu alƙawura na farawa ne lokacin da ka ga matashi yana nuna maka ƙirƙirarsa da ƙwazo duk da ƙarancin kayan aiki.
acteurs.sg_p2: Tun lokacin da aka kafa OPE, na haɗu da matasa masu fasaha daban-daban da ke buƙatar dama kawai.
acteurs.sg_p3: Wannan sansani zai tara matasa daga shekaru 12 zuwa 35 a fannonin STEAM, Ayyukan Cikin Gida da kuma Haɗin Kan Al'umma.
acteurs.sg_p4: Sake fasalin Nijar yana buƙatar zuba jari a kan matasan da za su jagoranci gobe.
acteurs.sg_p5: Ƙuduri na shi ne in kasance tare da waɗannan matasa don buɗe musu kofofi.
acteurs.sg_p6: Ga ku matasa: ku shiga kuma ku kawo ra'ayoyinku don bunkasa su.
acteurs.sg_p7: Ga abokan hulɗa: ku haɗa hannu da mu wajen gina wannan babban taron.
acteurs.sg_p8: Nijar ba sai ta nemi hazaka da nisa ba; kawai buɗe musu kofa muke buƙatar yi.
acteurs.orga_quote:
Tare mu gina ƙasar Nijar
Mu kasance masu kyakkyawan zato
acteurs.orga_p1: Sansanin 'Yan Ƙasa na Ƙwarewa da Ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire: basira ba ta duba shekaru.
acteurs.orga_p2: Agadez, Nijar. Ƙungiyar Haɓaka Ƙwarewa da Ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire (OPE) tana ƙaddamar da Sansanin 'Yan Ƙasa na Ƙwarewa da Ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire, wanda ke nuna a bayyane cewa: basira ba ta duba shekaru.
acteurs.orga_p3: Tun kafuwarta, OPE tana aiki ba dare ba rana don haɓaka ƙwarewa a tsakanin matasan Nijar. Tana gano basira, tana ƙarfafa su da ba su jagoranci, tana kuma mutunta ƙwazo, aiki da kishin kai. Wannan sansani zai faɗaɗa wannan aiki ta hanyar buɗe ƙofofi ga kowa, ƙarfafa kishin ƙasa da ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire.
acteurs.orga_p4: Sansanin yana tara matasa masu shekaru 12 zuwa 35, manya da ƙanana. Kowa yana da matsayinsa ta hanyoyi guda uku:
acteurs.orga_p5: • STEAM: ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire ta hanyar kimiyya, fasaha, injiniyanci, zane da lissafi.
acteurs.orga_p6: • Local Project: magance matsalolin al'umma ta hanyar amfani da albarkatun al'umma.
acteurs.orga_p7: • Modèle Communautaire Citoyen: mai da taimakon juna da kishin ƙasa a matsayin tsarin rayuwa.
acteurs.orga_p8: Wannan shiri ya samo asali ne a Agadez kuma yana da tushe a tarihinta. Hukunomin yanki da na gida, masarautun gargajiya da kuma al'umma, kowannensu a matakinsa, sun rungumi wannan aiki. Hukuma ta buɗe hanya ta kuma samar da yanayi mai kyau. Al'ummar gari mai cike da haɗin kai da karramawa ta ɗauki shirin da muhimmanci. Wannan haɗin gwiwa tsakanin hukumomi da al'umma shi ne ke sa OPE ta zama ta musamman a Agadez: a nan, ana gina ƙwarewa tare, da albarkatun da ke ƙasa.
